_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Two generic, jurisdiction-neutral procurement-governance controls abstracted from the retired purchaseq slug set (purchaseq#5). SupplierQualification: approve-before-first-PO onboarding with a duplicate-supplier check on taxId/IBAN and required documents/certificates that expire — enforced by SupplierQualificationGuard behind a default-OFF policy require_supplier_qualification_for_po. FrameworkAgreement: a supplier contract with a spend ceiling that PurchaseOrder call-offs draw down against — a call-off exceeding the remaining ceiling is blocked by FrameworkAgreementDrawdownGuard. Both consume OpenRegister's ObjectService (ADR-022) and reuse the existing PurchaseOrderService without re-implementing any business logic (ADR-031). Money fields are integer euro cents.

SupplierQualification.title: Supplier Qualification
SupplierQualification.description: Generic supplier onboarding/qualification record. A supplier must be qualified (all required documents provided and unexpired) before its first PurchaseOrder when the require_supplier_qualification_for_po policy is enabled. Registration rejects a duplicate supplier on taxId or IBAN. Abstracted from purchaseq's supplier-onboarding-vragenlijst as a jurisdiction-neutral control — no country-specific questionnaire is modelled.

taxId.description: Supplier tax/VAT identifier — checked for duplicates at registration (jurisdiction-neutral free string).
taxId.title: Tax / VAT ID

iban.description: Supplier bank account (IBAN) — checked for duplicates at registration.
iban.title: IBAN

requiredDocuments.description: Documents/certificates required to qualify the supplier. Each carries an optional expiry; an absent (provided=false) or expired document blocks qualification and the first PurchaseOrder.
requiredDocuments.title: Required Documents

documentType.description: Document/certificate type key (e.g. insurance-certificate, iso-9001, chamber-of-commerce-extract).
documentType.title: Document Type

provided.description: Whether the document has been provided.
provided.title: Provided

expiresAt.description: Expiry date; a document past this date counts as not valid.
expiresAt.title: Expires At

qualifiedAt.description: Server-authoritative timestamp the supplier became qualified.
qualifiedAt.title: Qualified At

qualifiedBy.description: User ID of the approver who qualified the supplier.
qualifiedBy.title: Qualified By

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Supplier registered; not yet qualified — cannot be used for a first PurchaseOrder while enforcement is on.

qualified.label: Gekwalificeerd
qualified.description: All required documents provided and unexpired; eligible for PurchaseOrders.

expired.label: Verlopen
expired.description: A required document has expired; re-qualification needed (terminal until renewed).

qualify.label: Kwalificeren
qualify.description: Qualify the supplier once every required document is provided and unexpired, enforced by SupplierQualificationService:qualify.

expire.label: Laten verlopen
expire.description: Mark the qualification expired when a required document lapses.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every registration/qualification/revocation of a SupplierQualification is logged to OR's immutable audit trail with actor + timestamp.

FrameworkAgreement.title: Framework Agreement
FrameworkAgreement.description: Generic framework agreement (raamovereenkomst abstracted): a supplier contract with a spend ceiling that PurchaseOrder call-offs draw down against. A call-off exceeding the remaining ceiling is blocked by FrameworkAgreementDrawdownGuard. Distinct from the generic Contract (contract-lifecycle-management), which has no ceiling/drawdown accounting. Money is integer euro cents (ADR-022).

agreementNumber.description: Auto-generated framework-agreement number, unique per administration.
agreementNumber.title: Agreement Number

supplierId.description: Supplier the agreement is with (matches PurchaseOrder.supplierId).
supplierId.title: Supplier

ceilingAmount.description: Maximum total spend the agreement authorises, in integer euro cents. Call-offs may not draw the cumulative drawn amount above this.
ceilingAmount.title: Ceiling Amount (cents)

drawnAmount.description: Cumulative amount already called off against the ceiling, in integer euro cents. Server-maintained by FrameworkAgreementService:recordCallOff.
drawnAmount.title: Drawn Amount (cents)

validFrom.description: Start of the agreement's validity window.
validFrom.title: Valid From

validUntil.description: End of the agreement's validity window; call-offs after this date are blocked.
validUntil.title: Valid Until

active.label: Actief
active.description: Agreement is live; call-offs are allowed up to the remaining ceiling within the validity window.

close.label: Afsluiten
close.description: Close the agreement; blocks further call-offs.

expire.label: Laten verlopen
expire.description: Mark the agreement expired past its validity window.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every call-off drawdown and status change of a FrameworkAgreement is logged to OR's immutable audit trail with actor + timestamp.
